params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, overhead view. A spread of small side dishes in off-white ceramic bowls: five crisp golden falafel with a small dish of tzatziki, a cucumber salad with red onion and herbs, a cup of esquite (corn with mayonnaise, cotija cheese, chili powder and a lime wedge), creamy hummus with olive oil and warm pita wedges, and a small bowl of Mexican red rice. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing but not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
